verdict.rationale: Mercury documents international wire payouts from its accounts and API (docs-46, docs-53). It also advertises no-fee USD payments around the globe (docs-7), which gives some fee transparency for USD sends. The evidence never shows payments in local or foreign currencies, so the core local-currency element of the story is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of sending in local/foreign currencies, published FX rates or markups for non-USD payments, a fee schedule for international wires, independent or hands-on corroboration.
